title: What happens when the GPS disappears?
standfirst: In defence, mining, industrial and remote operations, dust and uneven terrain degrade sensors, and communications drop out. Standard automation fails where GPS is denied or jammed and the environment has no structure.

hero.alt: A yellow wheeled robot branded AutoMind Dynamics, fitted with LiDAR, cameras and antennas, on a leaf-covered forest floor
hero.caption: A Husky wheeled robot branded AutoMind Dynamics, fitted with LiDAR, cameras and antennas, on a forest floor. Photograph from Automind Dynamics.

lead: Automind Dynamics builds autonomy for vehicles that work off the road, where GPS is jammed or missing and the ground is never the same twice. Its systems combine vehicle control, sensors, autonomy software and simulation to help vehicles operate across terrain that is unfamiliar, changing and difficult to model in advance.
It is incubated at ARTPARK and runs its R&D Innovation Centre on ARTPARK’s campus in Jalahalli, Bengaluru.

sections.h2: A kit, not a new vehicle.
blocks: The flagship product is TraX (short for Terrain Ready Autonomy eXtension), which allows remote teleoperation of vehicles from ground control stations. At its core, it is a retrofit kit that fits an existing vehicle, combustion or electric, allowing it to work autonomously. The software, sensors and simulation needed to make that work sit around it.

quote.text: A vehicle that has to keep going where there is no road, no map and no signal needs autonomy built for those conditions from the start.

figure.caption: The TraX Controller (design render). Image from Automind Dynamics.

panel.title: Our products
items: Hardware and software. A vehicle-agnostic drive-by-wire and autonomy kit, working with RGB, LiDAR, radar and thermal sensors over RF, 5G or a local network.
Software. Mapping, localisation, path planning and navigation across all terrain.
Software. Simulation software for testing and refining the autonomy stack.
Hardware. A fully autonomous indoor UGV for AI and robotics research, with integrated system architecture and a preconfigured autonomy stack.
Hardware. An off-road autonomous UGV built for defence missions where time on the ground matters: surveillance, reconnaissance and tactical logistics.

dates: Published a demonstration of the TraX ecosystem for off-road, GPS-denied autonomy.
Launched Gefier R1, a modular autonomous ground robot for university research and teaching.
Exhibited with ARTPARK at the Big Tech Show 2026, Mysuru.
Launched the R1 Vega Autonomous Vehicle.
